test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The PARAM Rudra supercomputer was inaugurated at which institute on 27 September 2024?

options.text: S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences (SNBNCBS), Kolkata
Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai
Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Bengaluru

solution:
The correct answer is __**S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences (SNBNCBS), Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PARAM Rudra supercomputer was inaugurated at **S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences (SNBNCBS), Kolkata** on 27 September 2024.
 
• PARAM Rudra is a high-performance computing (HPC) system developed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC).
 
• The supercomputer aims to provide significant computational power for scientific research and various advanced computing applications.
 
• This initiative is part of India's broader efforts to enhance its capabilities in computational science and engineering.
 
• PARAM Rudra is expected to boost research in fields such as material science, computational chemistry, and climate modeling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supercomputers in India:**

 
 
• India has been developing supercomputers through the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM), a collaborative initiative between the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
 
• The mission aims to install more than 70 high-performance computing (HPC) systems in the country by 2022.
 
 
 
• **Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC):**
 
 
• C-DAC is an autonomous scientific society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.
 
• It is the premier R&D organization for carrying out R&D in IT, Electronics, and associated areas.
 
 
 
• **High-Performance Computing (HPC):**
 
 
• HPC involves the use of supercomputers and parallel processing techniques for solving complex computational problems.
 
• It is crucial for scientific research, simulations, and data-intensive tasks.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Supercomputers:**
 
 
• Supercomputers are used in various fields including climate research, molecular modeling, quantum mechanics, and complex simulations.
 
• They help in solving large-scale problems faster than traditional computing methods.
